title: Setup Quality vs Outcome
hook: Grade the setup. Record the outcome. Separately.

launchpad.outcome: Build the quality × outcome matrix from your own data, with sample size on every number.
launchpad.missionQuestion: What does my evidence say about quality?

slides.title: Your matrix
lines: Quality (A / B / C / PASS) against outcome. Built only from what you’ve recorded.

slides.title: Keep them separate

items.q: Valid A setup. It loses. What do you record?

options.label: Downgrade it to C
options.say: The loss doesn’t rewrite the setup.

options.label: A + LOSS
options.say: Yes. Quality and outcome stay separate.

items.q: 2 A setups. Both won. What does the dashboard say?

options.label: A setups have a 100% win rate 🔥
2/2 · EARLY SAMPLE
options.say: Every metric travels with its sample size.

slides.principle: Data without sample context can create false confidence.

takeaways: N goes next to every number.
